top_signals.title: Russia’s pro-Putin party set to win election as Ukraine exposes war’s growing reach into Moscow
top_signals.summary: Ukraine launched more than 1,000 drones at Russia on the State Duma election’s final day, including hundreds targeting Moscow.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: X sues Bitcoin account operators over alleged $278K payout fraud
top_signals.summary: X alleges six Bitcoin-focused accounts coordinated posts and engagement to inflate creator payouts, with claimed and projected losses of at least $378,000.
